description: NOW IN STOCK!Our most anticipated launch since the viral Power Goat V3. Utilizes the unmatched mid drive system of the 62AH King Goat and dresses it up Power Goat style with a 3ft seat to accommodate a passenger, dual rear shocks, and front footrest so you can put your feet up and ride. Also Includes Kinetic Energy Recovery to recharge the battery. Works like Regenerative Braking but isn't limited to just braking. Any time the motor isn't actively working, it will work to recharge the battery.Now available in a 62.5AH frame battery option that utilizes SVolt EV batteries for superior performance and longevity. Each battery contains only 20 cells vs 240 Samsung 50GB cells.
